snippet.title: Nightmarise - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Climb through horror nightmare where every move and jump matters. Trapped in a dream, face the fear alone or with up to 3 friends. You must reach the top or never wake.

Nightmarise is a challenging climbing game mixed with psychological horror.

When you go to sleep, the nightmare begins. The ultimate goal is simple - you have to wake up. To do that, you'll need to climb and reach the top.

Find your way up through strange structures that don’t belong in the real world. Every jump matters. Every mistake sends you down again. Compete for time, help each other through the nightmare, or just try to reach the top before it consumes what’s left of your sanity.
